visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses wearing a black button-up shirt sits behind a dark table. He looks upward with an amazed expression, his hands raised palms up. The background is a dimly lit studio with warm accent lights and a bookshelf. (2) The man looks directly at the camera, speaking with animated hand gestures. On-screen subtitles appear at the bottom. (3) A digital screen capture of a scientific article from the journal 'Nature' titled 'Observation of an ultra-high-energy cosmic neutrino with KM3NeT' is shown, dated 12 February 2025. (4) Transition back to the man explaining the content of the article with expansive hand movements. (5) A technical diagram appears showing the 'ARCA layout' and 'ORCA layout' for the KM3NeT project, detailing underwater strings and sensors at depths of 2475m and 3450m. (6) A high-fidelity animation shows a grid of glowing optical modules suspended in dark water, connected by vertical cables. (7) A brief movie clip features a man in a beige suit entering a wooden door labeled '1621'. (8) Scientific visualization of a neutrino event within a 3D grid, showing a path of colored spheres representing particle interactions and light emission. (9) The man returns to the screen, gesturing toward his ear and then outward to emphasize the scale of the detection. (10) A final technical diagram depicts the 'IceCube Array' in Antarctica, showing the sensor strings embedded deep in the ice relative to the Eiffel Tower for scale. (11) The man points downward toward the bottom of the screen, encouraging viewers to follow for more information.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這是外星人給我們的訊息嗎? (2) [Subtitle]: 2025 年 2 月 12 號 物理學家在 Nature 上發表了最新研究. (3) [Subtitle]: 他們偵測到了來自宇宙最強的微中子訊號. (4) [Subtitle]: 要知道微中子通訊在科幻小說三體中是被外星人三體人拿來通訊的手段. (5) [Subtitle]: 這次的訊號會是來自外星人的聯絡嗎? (6) [Subtitle]: 發現這次微中子訊號的是地中海的微中子觀測站 KM3NeT. (7) [Subtitle]: 觀測站的建設可不簡單. (8) [Subtitle]: 這觀測站分為兩個部分, 分別在水深 2475 公尺和 3450 公尺深. (9) [Subtitle]: 之外大量的光學探測單元被數百公尺的纜線所串接, 漂浮在海水之中. (10) [Subtitle]: 會這麼麻煩的原因是因為微中子幾乎會穿過所有物質而且不起交互作用. (11) [Subtitle]: 簡單來說微中子幾乎會在不觸發任何探測器的情況下穿牆而過. (12) [Subtitle]: 因此偵測微中子的做法是讓微中子穿過數千公尺深的海水. (13) [Subtitle]: 微中子有很小的機率會跟水分子起作用, 釋放電子或緲子等帶電粒子. (14) [Subtitle]: 當這些粒子出現時可能超過水中的光速產生契忍可夫輻射. (15) [Subtitle]: 最後這股淡藍色的輻射會被漂在海水中的光學探測單元捕捉到. (16) [Subtitle]: 物理學家還要經過回推才能算出原本微中子的樣貌. (17) [Subtitle]: 那這次的微中子來自哪裡? (18) [Subtitle]: 真的三體星嗎? (19) [Subtitle]: 我們還不知道. (20) [Subtitle]: 這次的微中子能量是過去有記錄以來最強訊號的 30 倍. (21) [Subtitle]: 目前科學家推測微中子很有可能來自某些大型的天文事件. (22) [Subtitle]: 例如伽馬射線暴或是來自超高能宇宙射線與宇宙背景輻射的交互作用. (23) [Subtitle]: 不管如何都是高能天文學和粒子物理學的重要研究對象. (24) [Subtitle]: 甚至可能幫助物理學家研究為什麼這個宇宙的正物質會比反物質還要多. (25) [Subtitle]: 要全面瞭解微中子只有一個觀測站絕對不夠. (26) [Subtitle]: 與位於北半球地中海的 KM3NeT 相對的是位在南半球世界最大的微中子探測器「冰立方」. (27) [Subtitle]: 但你知道為什麼冰立方要建在南極嗎? (28) [Subtitle]: 趕快點這邊來瞭解.
